name: AbRank: A Sequence- and Lineage-Disjoint 3-State Antibody-Antigen Mutation Effect and Affinity Ranking Benchmark
description: AbRank standardizes 20-amino-acid sequence-complete antibody-antigen and single-domain nanobody (VHH) binding measurements across 24 public experimental sources spanning 192 cataloged antigen groups (161 non-viral, 31 viral; 47 core Kd groups with >=5 measurements, 22 <50%-identity LOACO local mutation clusters, 19 candidate clusters, and 25 unfiltered variant panels) and 851 3D structural scaffolds (340 experimental RCSB PDB co-crystals + 511 unbound IgFold Fv/VHH + RCSB antigen scaffolds) under empirically calibrated 3-state noise-buffered ranking ({-1: Depleted, 0: Neutral, +1: Improved}).
rai:dataCollection: Curated and harmonized from 24 publicly released peer-reviewed biophysical and functional screening datasets (SPR, BLI, KinExA, ITC, yeast/phage/ribosome display enrichment, interface DMS, ELISA, pseudovirus IC50, and viral escape DMS), with full provenance and upstream licenses documented in metadata/sources_manifest.yaml.
rai:dataCollectionType: Secondary data aggregation and sequence/structural standardization
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Stripping recombinant signal peptides, His/Avi/Strep/foldon tags, and CH1/CL constant regions to exact variable Fv/VHH and assayed ectodomain constructs
Strict 20-standard-amino-acid verification and removal of unresolved X/censored-floor artifacts
Log10 replicate aggregation within identical (VH, VL, Ag, Dataset, Modality) tuples
Pre-pair connected-component clustering of homologous antigens (>=50% global sequence identity + >=25 AA substring containment) and antibody clonal lineages (>=80% Fv/VHH identity)
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: None. All records consist exclusively of non-personal molecular amino acid sequences (recombinant or in vitro-assayed antibodies, nanobodies, and purified protein antigens) and biochemical binding measurements.
rai:dataBiases: Public antibody binding databases overrepresent viral surface glycoproteins (Influenza HA, SARS-CoV-2 Spike, HIV-1 Env) and oncology targets (HER2, EGFR, PD-1/PD-L1). AbRank mitigates target-volume skew via sublinear sqrt(N) pair sampling caps, equal-weight per-antigen macro-averaging (>=5 pairs), and 22-cluster Leave-One-Antigen-Cluster-Out (LOACO) evaluation.
rai:dataLimitations: 3D inverse-folding scores are strongest when wild-type experimental co-crystal coordinates are available (Regime I); de novo candidate panels without solved co-crystals rely on unbound IgFold Fv/VHH models (Regime II). Dual-use biosafety note: viral neutralization and escape tracks include published historical HIV-1 and coronavirus strain sequences solely for defensive vaccine/therapeutic research.
rai:dataUseCases: Benchmarking sequence-based and 3D structure-conditioned antibody/nanobody affinity predictors
Evaluating hot-spot impact detection (neutral vs. consequential mutations) and directional affinity ranking on unseen biological targets
Studying cross-assay transfer from monomeric Kd to ELISA, ΔΔG, DMS, viral IC50 neutralization, and escape

distribution.name: assays_kd.tsv
distribution.description: Core paired-chain dissociation constant (Kd) master table (16 sources, 148 cataloged antigen groups, 47 groups with >=5 assays, and 262 clonal lineages).

distribution.name: assays_cross_modal.tsv
distribution.description: Cross-modal relative binding readouts across Enrichment (incl. NbBench Galectin-3 VHH), AbAgym 45-complex DMS, AbDesign ELISA & ΔΔG, and Kothiwal EC50.

distribution.name: assays_transfer.tsv
distribution.description: Functional viral neutralization IC50 (HIV-1 Env and Coronavirus Spike) and SARS-CoV-2 RBD escape DMS master table.

distribution.name: assays_vhh.tsv
distribution.description: Single-domain nanobody (VHH) Kd master table (8 sources, 50 cataloged antigen groups, 11 groups with >=5 evaluable pairs).

distribution.name: unseen_ag_splits
distribution.description: Canonical zero-leakage unseen-antigen (<50% Ag identity, <80% Ab identity) 3-state pairwise splits and unfiltered pointwise variant panels.

field.name: binding_score
field.description: Standardized pKd = 9 - log10(Kd [nM]), higher means stronger binding.

recordSet.name: three_state_pairs
recordSet.description: 3-state noise-buffered pairwise comparisons ({-1: Depleted, 0: Neutral, +1: Improved}).
